info.syllabusName: Quản lý mua hàng và cung ứng (Procurement and Supply Management)
info.description:
The 
Procurement and Supply Management
 course provides a comprehensive and systematic understanding of the principles, strategies, and practices of purchasing within the context of modern supply chains. Key topics include: the strategic role of purchasing in building competitive advantage; procurement policies, processes, and supporting tools; supplier relationship management and collaborative partnerships; legal frameworks and contract management; quality management, inventory control, and balancing supply and demand; strategic and global sourcing; pricing, cost analysis, and risk management; sustainable procurement and corporate social responsibility; negotiation skills and category management. Students will explore contemporary models, tools, and technologies such as e-procurement, SRM, VMI, and MRP/ERP, and apply them to real-world case analysis, thereby developing capabilities in planning, cost optimization, risk mitigation, and enhancing end-to-end supply chain performance.

clos.loDetails: Equip students with the ability to identify, analyze, and evaluate the strategic role of purchasing within the supply chain, in line with globalization trends and sustainable development.
Develop students’ skills in planning purchasing activities and integrating them with inventory, production, logistics, and distribution to optimize operational efficiency.

Provide students with the capability to apply tools, techniques, and technologies (e.g., SRM, e-procurement, cost analysis, contract management) to enhance purchasing performance and supplier management.
Encourage students to propose purchasing improvement initiatives and sustainable strategies to optimize costs, mitigate risks, and meet international environmental and social standards.
